summary: The publisher reports 171 selected genes for 22-month versus 12-week mouse hypothalamus. Of these, 152 have a registered coefficient, all 152 agree in direction, and 133 meet both adjusted cutoffs at 0.05. Coverage of the selected author list is 88.89%, below the 90% author-concordance-v2 requirement.

manualReview.summary: Aged versus young hypothalamus effects agree in direction for all 152 matched genes from the publisher’s 171-gene DEG list.
manualReview.note: The GEO counts match the registered input SHA-256. GEO assigns AMHT1–3 to 22 months and YMHT1–3 to 12 weeks. Both publisher QC tables name these libraries, and all 1,026 expression cells in the DEG table match the corresponding deposited FPKM values within 4.27e-8. The registered expression filter accounts for all 19 unpaired author genes. Across the 152 pairs, Pearson is 0.999607, Spearman is 0.999887 and 133 meet both adjusted cutoffs. The pairs cover 152/171 selected author genes (88.89%) and 152/14,702 registered genes (1.03%).
reviewFlags: The selected list omits the full author testing universe. Reference coverage falls below the 90% policy minimum. Full verification remains open.
GEO names the legacy DESeq nbinomTest. The exported statistic, coefficient, SE and P values have a Wald-style relationship. The original fit and q-value procedure are unconfirmed.

The sample sheet records six males, and the GEO sample records give age and tissue without a per-library sex annotation. Several Y-linked transcripts are much more abundant in all three AMHT libraries. Agreement between analyses of the same libraries cannot resolve the biological explanation.

verificationReview.reason: The retained publisher table supports a direct comparison of the selected age-group DEGs. All 152 paired coefficients agree in sign, all 152 pairs meet both raw P cutoffs, and 133 meet both adjusted cutoffs at 0.05. Another 19 paired genes meet only the author adjusted cutoff. A separate 19 author genes were filtered before registered testing. This gives 152/171 selected-reference coverage (88.89%), below the v2 minimum.
verificationReview.nextStep: For a full-universe inference review, obtain the unfiltered author result table and the model code or saved fit, including the contrast, filtering and q-value calculation. The selected-gene comparison is complete.

comparabilityReview.basis: Every published gene_id was matched by exact, case-sensitive symbol to the registered aged_vs_young output. Effects are the reported log2FoldChange and the registered edgeR-QL logFC. The six expression columns independently confirm library identity and effect direction.
comparabilityReview.reference: Tian et al., Behavioural Brain Research, DOI 10.1016/j.bbr.2024.114943, publisher supplement mmc3.xls. The original bytes are tab-delimited text. The GEO family record and publisher QC supplements mmc1.docx and mmc2.docx identify the samples.

cohort.note: GEO records three mice sequenced from each behavioral group of five. GSM7696818–20 are AMHT1–3 (22 months) and GSM7696821–23 are YMHT1–3 (12 weeks). The publisher QC and DEG tables and the registered sample sheet identify the same six libraries. The sheet records male sex for all six. GEO does not supply individual sex annotations, and Ddx3y and other Y-linked transcripts show a large age-group difference in these libraries. The cohort match refers to the labeled libraries.

contrast.note: Whole hypothalamus at 22 months minus 12 weeks. For all 171 author genes the reported direction agrees with aged versus young mean expression in the six labeled columns. The orientation sign is +1 throughout.

features.note: The 171 author symbols and 14,702 registered symbols are unique within their tables. Exact symbol matching yields 152 pairs. All 19 others map unchanged in the deposited input and registered feature map and have no row in the filtered registered output. The individual symbols are in paired.tsv.

effects.note: The reported signed log2FoldChange corresponds to the log2 of the author’s FoldChange and uses the same age direction and log2 ratio units as registered logFC. All 152 nonzero pairs agree in sign. Pearson is 0.999607, Spearman is 0.999887 and median absolute log2FC difference is 0.009705. The largest absolute difference is 0.599887.

inference.note: All 171 selected author genes have q < 0.05 and |log2FoldChange| > 1. The exact selection rule is unknown. All 152 pairs meet both raw P cutoffs of 0.05. At the same adjusted cutoff, 133 meet both and 19 meet only the author cutoff. Of the 987 registered FDR discoveries, 854 lack an author row, so their author statistics remain unassessed. The export has Wald-style statistics, GEO names legacy DESeq, and the registered fit uses edgeR-QL.

coverage.note: 152/171 selected author genes have registered coefficients (88.89%). The same 152 pairs cover 1.033873% of the 14,702 registered genes. The other 14,550 registered genes have no author row. The full author testing universe is unknown.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use all exact unique symbols in the published table, the registered orientation and finite pairs. For selected results, author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30 pairs and 90% reference coverage, plus Pearson and Spearman each at least 0.90 or at least 90% direction agreement in at least 30 nonzero pairs covering at least 90% of all pairs. Compare raw and adjusted P values separately at 0.05 for context.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Both correlation and direction meet the numerical cutoffs on paired genes. The independent selected-reference coverage requirement is unmet. The review closes for the published list, with full-universe inference and full verification unassessed.

additionalComparisonSpec.localMethod: edgeR-QL on counts, TMM normalization and groupcase coefficient
additionalComparisonSpec.authorMethod: Published log2 fold-change estimates with SE, Wald-style statistic, raw P and q-value. GEO documents DESeq (2012) nbinomTest. The exact generating code and adjustment procedure are unavailable.
additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: Aged (AMHT, 22 months) minus young (YMHT, 12 weeks), with direction confirmed from the author expression columns.
additionalComparisonSpec.note: Selected author result list. Compare every published row and retain absent registered rows in the coverage denominator. The q-value column is the author adjusted statistic. Pairs support both effect routes, with 152/171 selected genes covered, below the 90% gate. Author values outside this list remain unassessed.
additionalComparisonSpec.resultScope: Selected author DEGs for aged versus young hypothalamus.

openIssues: The public DEG supplement contains selected rows. A complete author result with all tested genes, including nonselected genes, is needed to assess full-universe inference.
The original model code or saved fit is needed to reconcile GEO’s legacy DESeq method description with the exported Wald-style statistics and to establish how the reported q values were calculated.

The published design and registered sheet describe male mice. Individual specimen records would help interpret the marked group difference in Y-linked counts. The two analyses use the same six labeled libraries.
